dict.string: Inner Light uses an alarm to wake you into your morning practice — through Silent mode and Sleep Focus.

Inner Light uses the camera for two optional things: a check-in, and a pulse reading taken with a fingertip over the lens before and after a practice. Both are analysed on this device only. No image is ever saved, and nothing leaves your phone.

Inner Light listens for your out-breath during The Tree You Breathe, so the tree grows as you breathe rather than on a timer. The sound is measured on this device only. No audio is ever recorded, saved, or sent anywhere.
